title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — October 29, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B6.4 (Peaked October 28, 2026 at 12:52 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 369 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Nothing unusual at the moment. ✨🖤

A broad coronal-hole region and several bright EUV active areas are visible, with no clear large outward structure in the coronagraph.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 284 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
